subject: Mutual action plan: gating matrix & retention decisions (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA)
messages:
From: Devon Lee <devon.lee@brightharbor.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@brightharbor.com>
Date: Sun, 23 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro / MAP & compliance checkpoints

Hannah —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We need to pull together a mutual action plan so our security team can sign off. High level asks from Bright Harbor: SOC 2 evidence (system description + control narratives), completed SIG/CAIQ, and DPA redlines agreed before procurement can issue a PO. Also a quick decision on data retention windows for hosted vs private deployment (we're leaning toward 90 days token logs, 7 years archived metadata — but we need to confirm).

Can you send a proposed timeline and owner list that ties those gates to signoff? We have a compliance review meeting the afternoon of 5/28 and it'd be great to show progress.

—Devon
Security Operations, Bright Harbor

Attachments: BRIGHT-SIG-CAIQ-questions.pdf (pdf, 84KB)

From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
To: Devon Lee <devon.lee@brightharbor.com>
Cc: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@brightharbor.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Mutual action plan: gating matrix & retention decisions (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA)

Devon —

Thanks — attached is an initial gating matrix that maps each compliance gate to a deliverable, owner, and target date. Short summary below and the plan is intentionally aggressive so you have something to present on 5/28: 

1) SIG/CAIQ: Redwood will run through the Bright Harbor questionnaire, supply evidence links and a redlined response by 5/26. Owner: Neha Kapoor (Security & Trust).
2) SOC 2 evidence: We can provide system overview, control narratives, and sample evidence by 5/28 for your internal review; final artifact handoff by 6/04 pending audit log packaging. Owner: Ben Carter (Compliance).
3) DPA: We'll circulate DPA redline (v3) by 5/25 with our standard data residency and retention options. We ask Bright Harbor to propose any carveouts by 5/27 for negotiation. Owner: Hannah Schmitt (Sales / Legal coordination).
4) Data retention decision: Two recommended buckets: ephemeral request logs (retained 30/90/180 days options) and archival metadata (1/3/7 years). Please confirm preference; if you choose 90 days + 7 years archive we will prepare the annex language for signoff. Target decision date: 5/27.

I attached the gating matrix (spreadsheet stub) and the initial DPA redline. We'll also link to the SOC 2 system description PDF. If that timeline works I'll lock owners into calendar slots for the 5/25-5/28 window.

Thanks, Hannah
Hannah Schmitt | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference runtime

Attachments: DPA-redline-v3.docx (docx, 23KB); SOC2-system-overview.pdf (pdf, 112KB)

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Devon Lee <devon.lee@brightharbor.com>, Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@brightharbor.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Mutual action plan: gating matrix & retention decisions (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA)

Looping in a couple technical clarifications we should confirm before we finalize the gating matrix: 

- For SOC 2 evidence, Bright Harbor asks for sample config snapshots and alerting playbooks. We can export those but need a one-way S3 share (read-only) or a secure share link. Devon/Priya — can you confirm access method?
- SIG items: a few CAIQ answers require environment-specific telemetry (e.g., KV cache persistence, backup cadence). Ben — can you prepare short notes on retention and backup cadence to drop into the CAIQ responses?
- Retention annex: We should propose a default: 90 days token logs + 7 years minimal metadata (searchable index trimmed at 2 years). If BH wants the 30-day option instead, price uplift applies.

I'll draft the CAIQ responses and drop into the shared drive; expect first pass by EOD 5/26.

—Neha
Director, Security & Trust, Redwood Inference

From: Devon Lee <devon.lee@brightharbor.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@brightharbor.com>, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: gating matrix & retention decisions (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA)

Hannah / team —

This looks good and aligns with our internal timeline. Quick answers: 

- Access method: we can provide a pre-authorized read-only S3 bucket for evidence intake; I'll send details to Neha's email.
- Retention: Bright Harbor will target the 90 days token logs + 7 years archive (please send annex language). Our legal team will review the DPA redline v3 and push back on the keystore / escrow clause — expect comments by 5/27 evening.

Can you confirm whether audit logs for the hosted API can be exported in CSV with field-level timestamps (we need that for our SIEM ingestion). If yes, we'll include a short note in our procurement packet.

Thanks — Devon

On Thu, May 27, 2027 at 09:05 AM hannah_schmitt@redwood.com wrote:
> Devon —
>

>

Subject: Mutual action plan: gating matrix & retention decisions (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA) — finalized actions

Team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per the 5/28 compliance meeting, here's the agreed MAP snapshot and next steps: 

- SIG/CAIQ: Neha to upload first-pass CAIQ responses to the shared Drive by 5/26 (done). Devon confirmed S3 intake for supplemental evidence.
- SOC 2 evidence: Ben to deliver system overview + control narratives + sample CSV export for audit logs by 6/04. (Ben note: package will include example CSV + schema).
- DPA: Hannah to circulate amended DPA annex (retention: 90 days token logs; archive metadata retained for 7 years; price uplift waived as a good-faith on initial commitment). DPA redline v4 link below.
- Procurement: Bright Harbor to deliver PO once DPA final is agreed (target: 6/10).

Related links & artifacts: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890 (HubSpot company), https://na01.redwood.com/docs/DPA-redline-v3 (DPA draft).

If anything changes to the S3 access or evidence packaging, please flag immediately. I'll schedule a quick sync on 6/02 to confirm the SOC 2 handoff readiness.

Best,
Hannah
